notes.title: All Infos Before The Release - Beyond The Evil Pre-Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're finally near the release date of the game, so we're sharing some useful infos about the game including chapters, endings, playtime, specs, languages & more. So let's start with the basic:

[previewyoutube=mHTsNHsfIf4;full][/previewyoutube]

ALL CHAPTERS
The Game Has 5 Chapters, Including 8+ Scenes. Here They Are!

I - REVELATIONS
The Revelation Of The Case. Gary Nephew, One Rookie Investigator Got One Strange Call and Went To Investigate Caller Home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/6b1368479a4d1d9245e37aa91fd5a1ad69bf125f.png
The Family Prodigy - Caller Destiny

II - BLOODLINES
Aka the demo scene, Gary Went To Investigate The House of Dresden Juniper, Brother of Matthew Juniper.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/8045e07d289f29cd81e82a366ff2d8f168807fc0.png
The Prologue - Dresden's House

III - DEAD END
Gary Went To Lupau Street To Find More Clues About Matthew Juniper.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/367a0889b1c847b1abfe02707430bc83e358c846.png
Gas Station - Lupau Street

IV - THE EXPLORER
Gary Got Lost And Went To Investigate One Strange Location That He Never Heard About.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/ce2440567f5cb2b72cffb27ced7f73195f5da96f.png
The Angels Nest

V - CHOICES
Gary Went To The Final Step To Finish His Case, But At What Cost?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/6c831ef7a0f4d0f25198727ba3ba6bae084f071a.png
The Mansion - Choices

REPLAY VALUE
Different Endings:

The Game Have 3 Different Endings (Including a secret one!)
Be Careful with The Choices!

Achievements:
There will be 23 Achievements available in game
Including secret items to be found in the scenes!

AVAILABLE LANGUAGES
Since We're From Brazil, We only focused to release the game with ENGLISH and PORTUGUESE(BRA) in the general options.
More Languages will be released in the future (Free Updates).

MORE DETAILS

Game Playtime:

About ~3-5h -> Depends on the player.

PC Specs:

Minimum:
CPU: Intel Core i5 2400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
RAM: 8 GB de RAM
GPU: Nvidia Geforce GTX 750TI 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB
DirectX: 11
HDD: 21 GB

Recommended:
CPU: Intel Core i5 8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
RAM: 8 GB de RAM
GPU: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1660 6GB / AMD RX 580 4GB
DirectX: 11
HDD: 21 GB

Price:

USA (Reference) - $12.99
BRL - R$ 36.99

We Hope The Game Succeeds! Made With Love <3
#beyondtheevil
See You In The Release Date!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676050/Beyond_The_Evil/

- BlackHawk Games.

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames

notes.title: Beyond The Evil is now Delayed! | New Planned Release Date (Not Final)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! After some days, we've finally got time to clarify why the game got delayed. Here's why:
Since The Launch of the Demo, we've got a lot of interesting suggestions that could improve the game. With that being said, a lot of things aren't finished yet, including scenes, puzzles, optimization and more. 
We want Beyond The Evil being very good produced and polished as the people and us expect to be.
If anyone have anymore suggestion, please comment below!
(Or send Via Discord: https://discord.gg/wcnPScbg2S) 
We would love new ideas from some other people, since this is our first campaign project.
About the release date, this isn't the final yet, we might change in the future.


EXPECTED RELEASE DATE:
12.09.2022


We hope that everyone understands our feelings about the game, we'll try our best to make this project great!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676050/Beyond_The_Evil/

- BlackHawk Games.

notes.title: New Upcoming Beta Test and Update for Beyond The Evil!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! We're finally finishing the Chapter 01 of Beyond The Evil! Here is the newest things:

Beyond The Evil - Test 2

The game is having another test just to make sure that the first chapter don't have any annoying bug or bad optimization on the chapter scenes.

This Test will be open for all the Streamers/Youtubers that want to participate! To participate, enter our discord server and send one message on the #general chat, then we'll contact you:
https://discord.gg/wcnPScbg2S

CHAPTER 01: The Prologue

THE CONTINUATION

The Chapter 01 is now finished with one new scene that will be showcased later on the steam page and on the news later.

New Letters

Changed a lot of letters and added new ones to add more atmosphere and feeling to the scenes!

Puzzle Remake

Since the first test got finished, we got the conclusion that some of the puzzles of the game were a bit messed up and too hard to be done.
Also we changed the quantity of keys of the first scene and increased the number of notes to make the puzzles harder.

Lightning Optimization and Improvement

We've managed to improve the house lightning and the optimization on the First Scene (Abandoned House).

RESOURCES

 -  Updated the Store Page Screenshots.
 -  Updated the Game Image.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/de5350cfa05ec32eb4afbe055322deea112cb93b.jpg

BUG FIXES

 -  Fixed one key that didn't showed up the correct name on the inventory.
 -  Fixed one bug that made the scene disappear when walking on the living room.
